summary: include_tasks options: apply for task keywords on included tasks, file, and free-form; loops and conditionals apply to the statement itself, and do-until is not supported.
questions: How do I apply become to tasks in an included file?

answer_card.title: include_tasks parameters
answer_card.answer_md:
- `file` or free-form
- `apply`: keywords (`tags`, `become`) applied to included tasks
- Loops, `with_items`, conditionals apply to the **include statement**. `until` loops are not supported.
